messages:
sam: Heads up — saw edge proxy started emitting full req/resp proto in debug logs on canary. Concern: headers may contain emails/API keys. We need sampling+redaction plan. cc @elaine
elaine: Which canary? mux-proxy v2? I thought we masked Authorization header already.
jason: If true we should flip canary off. Is this just a logging level (`debug`) or unredact flag?
maria: We added structured logs for debug to help root cause. The code path uses `serialize_proto_for_inspect=true` — we missed the scrub step before writing. PR incoming: #4021
prod-analytics-bot: Alert: high-cardinality header field discovered: X-User-Email in logs 23 occurrences in last 1h.
elaine: :eyes: Thanks. Short-term: can we enforce server-side header allowlist at ingress? e.g., drop known PII headers unless `inspect=true` and tenant opt-in.
sam: Proposals: (1) route-level sample+mask default (2) inspect-mode with TTL & audit trail (3) console toggle per-route with guardrail showing estimated cost/retention.
jason: Implementation notes: prefer deterministic sampling by tenant+route hash to avoid bias. Sampling decisions must be logged to audit log (no PII).
maria: For redaction heuristics: remove simple patterns (email, SSN, phone), and fast-hash salts per-tenant for pseudonymization. Keep raw in ephemeral unmask store with 1hr TTL and HMAC access logs.
elaine: UX: Console needs a clear affordance: 'Inspect mode (ephemeral unmask)' with TTL slider, who can enable, and a one-click revoke. Also show sample rate and estimated cost.
sam: Edge cases: embeddings/partial outputs might leak PII in tokens. Suggest we run token-level deid before storage and flag routes that produce high PII score for stricter defaults.
jason: Agree. Also quota concerns: sampled inspect traffic should count against a separate debug quota to avoid billing surprises. Add per-team 'debug budget'.
maria: PR ready to stop debug canary and add guard: scrub before log write. Also adding `X-Inspect-Request` header opt-in that requires header HMAC signed by console to prevent accidental enablement.
oncall-bot: Note: rolling back canary in 10m as requested by @maria.
sam: Thanks. Action items: maria will revert canary + push scrub, jason to draft deterministic sampler RFC, elaine to spec console affordance + audit UX, I'll open a billing ticket for debug quota. Anyone else?
elaine: I'll join on the RFC review. Also propose adding automatic alert for top-5 leaked header values daily.
maria: Revert PR: #4022 merged. scrub in place. Rolling restart.
prod-analytics-bot: Resolved: high-cardinality header alert suppressed after scrub.
sam: :thumbsup: We'll follow up with postmortem-ish doc in eng-platform wiki. Thx.
